comparison.objective: Square a racked wooden face frame by equalizing its diagonals; candidate sets a gripper stop angle and locks it.
comparison.physical_skill: Frame squaring uses opposed forces to shear an articulated workpiece into geometry, without tools or a locking fastener; candidate requires precise screw adjustment and nut countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Checks diagonal difference, outline containment, damage/lift avoidance, release, and stillness; candidate checks 90° accuracy, both nuts, repeated cycles, drift, and clearance.
comparison.reason: Both regulate geometry under reaction forces, but only the candidate tests retaining a calibrated threaded setting through locking and functional cycling.
